prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app dashboard concept at 1440×900
Primary request: Redesign the authenticated Wicker Study dashboard as ‘Study Itinerary’: a day planner crossed with a route sheet. The student should instantly see what matters now, what comes next, and one action to begin studying.
Input image: the current Wicker Study dashboard screenshot is a style and product reference. Preserve its left navigation chrome, warm neutral canvas, Archivo-like condensed headings and numerals, near-black navy ink, and single indigo signal color. Do not preserve the current dashboard composition or its excessive empty horizontal bands.
Composition/framing: exact desktop product UI screenshot, straight-on, no device mockup. Keep the 200px left sidebar. In the content area, create a bold asymmetric 8-column layout: a dominant Today route occupies roughly two thirds of the width, with a vertical indigo path connecting NOW, NEXT, and LATER. The NOW stop is the focal working plane containing ‘Nothing scheduled today’, a succinct explanation, and a clear ‘Start a practice set’ action. NEXT shows ‘Exam week · Period 1 — 39 days’ and LATER shows ‘Study week · Period 1 — 46 days’. A compact right rail contains ‘Study queue’ with Questions, Flashcards, Mistakes; ‘Course readiness’ with BCS1540 Algorithmic Design 0% and BCS1520 Statistics 15%; and a tiny 28-day activity strip. A compact header says ‘Thursday, 3 September’, ‘Period 1 · week 1 of 8’, plus the five-period measure.
Style/medium: polished real SaaS UI, dense but calm, grid-aligned, ruled lists instead of card wallpaper. One dark navy focus block may be used for the NOW stop; everything else uses white planes and hairlines.
Text (verbatim where visible): ‘Wicker Study’, ‘Thursday, 3 September’, ‘Period 1 · week 1 of 8’, ‘Your study route’, ‘Nothing scheduled today’, ‘Start a practice set’, ‘Exam week · Period 1’, ‘39 days’, ‘Study queue’, ‘Course readiness’, ‘BCS1540’, ‘Algorithmic Design’, ‘BCS1520’, ‘Statistics’.
Constraints: preserve real product meaning; functional UI only; sharp readable hierarchy; accessible contrast; no marketing hero; no photography; no gradients; no glass; no oversized greeting; no generic metric-card grid; no decorative illustration; no invented commercial claims; no watermark.
